# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and teacher  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c9 P8](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella Maynard is a very handsome, vivid girl with black eyes and a rosy-red complexion. She is known for her beauty among the students at Redmond College.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella possesses a heart full of wistful dreams and rainbow-like fancies, despite being occasionally troubled by moments of discouragement or brain fag. She can be rather critical of others, such as Philippa Gordon's flirtatiousness, and holds pessimistic views about marriage. Although she sometimes despises novel-writing, she enjoys humorous and tearful stories written by her friends. She is a loyal friend who values deep spiritual inspiration and purpose in life.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c10 P15](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0015), [v3 c16 P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014)_

## Traits

- Vivid and dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Critical of flirtatious behavior
- Pessimistic about romance  <sub>[v3 c16 P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014)</sub>
- Prone to occasional moods of discouragement  <sub>[v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v2 c9 P8](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- Academic aptitude across various subjects  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To pursue higher education at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>
- To live in a house with her friends instead of boarding  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley, Priscilla Grant, and Ruby Gillis, where she was part of their story-writing club. After completing her course at Queen's, she taught in a country school for two years, an experience she found full of trials and demanding parents. Eager to further her education and escape boarding, she decided to attend Redmond College, entering as a Sophomore. She proposed to Anne and Priscilla that they rent a house together along with her Aunt Jamesina as housekeeper. They successfully leased Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, where she lived happily with Anne, Priscilla, Philippa Gordon, and Aunt Jamesina throughout her remaining college years. Stella completed her Arts course at Redmond, achieving a solid all-round academic standing at graduation, and subsequently accepted a position teaching in Vancouver.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
